scope: exact manifest entry directories only; no ancestors, no globbing

process_use_scan.note: Unreadable /proc entries belong to other users' processes and to setuid/sshd-style processes of this user; those are permission limits, not observed use. All readable cwd/root/exe/fd/maps/cmdline references were checked.

disk.note: Allocated bytes are the sum of st_blocks*512 for unlinked files. Observed filesystem free-space change also reflects concurrent host writes from other jobs, so the two figures need not match.
